_meta.rule: queue(view, standing) = transitions of the view's family whose from = view.state and whose roles meet standing; one item per transition; the door admits by the same predicate

steps.note: Three people sit down: a founder authorizes the trust root's charter; the other two cosign under the accord's quorum
Bob makes a key: the key record is his own
Bob announces a device: his binding at federation scope
Carol asks to be a contact; her request is her own row
Bob founds a room: the roster's first version
Bob proposes Dave; the second voice is Dave's own acceptance
Dave posts in the room
A stranger tries to withdraw Dave's post: no standing, no item, refused
Dave posts again
Frank, the room's moderator, withholds the second post: one signature, the window decides
Carol objects to the withhold: a vote row under the two-path policy
Dave recants his first post: one step, no window
Bob's agent signs its own trace
Carol withdraws her contact consent: her own forward-only act
Bob tries to sign a transport report for his own device: refused, the report is the edge's own
The edge on Bob's device reports its own link, under the duty its owner conferred
The edge reports what it delivered
The edge reports which peers it can reach
The edge reports where its keys stop
Dave tries to name Bob's phone: refused, a device's name is its owner's
Bob names his phone: the owner's row, and it stays in his own circle
Dave saves a file: its author's row
Dave makes a folder: its creator's row
A stranger tries to acknowledge a chunk of the room's stream: refused, a receipt is a member's
Dave acknowledges a chunk of the room's stream: a current member's receipt
A stranger tries to wrap the room's key to herself: refused, a wrap is the sealer's
Bob wraps the room's key to Dave: the sealer's row
A fresh rendezvous key publishes its own route: attester and subject are the one key
A monitoring node records what it saw from where it stands
The monitoring node records what its probe assumes about access
A build pipeline signs the manifest of what it built; the reader judges its standing
The pipeline signs the manifest of one language's build
Bob's agent defers a question it should not decide alone
Bob, the agent's steward, seats Grace over the agent's deferrals: his own delegation, bearing the answering as its scope
The agent tries to answer its own deferral: refused, no seat is the agent's to hold over itself
Dave, whom nobody seated, tries to answer: refused as unseated
Grace answers from the seat Bob conferred
The agent defers again
Bob answers this one himself: the conferrer keeps the duty he delegates
Dave tries to grant Carol's partnership for her: refused, the grant is her own
Carol offers Bob's agent a partnership: her own grant
Carol tries to accept for the agent: refused, the acceptance is the other side's
The agent accepts: the producer's own row
Carol says what the partnership may be used for
Carol grants a bundle of her streams
The agent commits to how fast it deletes
Carol withdraws the partnership: forward only
The agent reports the decay of what it held, stage by stage
Carol tries to sign that the deletion is done: refused, that report is the producer's
The agent reports the deletion complete
Dave tries to grant the capture of Bob's node's traces: refused, that grant is the node owner's
Bob grants it for the node he owns
The agent signs a summary of its own trace
Bob's node returns its share of the census to a serve seat
Bob tries to publish a seat's sum: refused, a sum is a serve seat's
A serve seat publishes the sum of the shares it accepted
The seat publishes the count the two sums make
Dave sends his community cell to a tally member, as every member does every period
Dave tries to publish a tally member's sum: refused, he was not drawn
Carol, drawn as a tally member, publishes her sum into the room
Carol publishes how many members the room expects to be active
Carol publishes a poll's tally
A stranger tries to cast a ballot for moderator: refused, a ballot is a live member's
Dave ranks his choices for moderator
Carol casts her ballot
Carol withdraws her ballot: her own act, counted as withdrawn
Dave tries to accept the seat: refused, the count did not yield him
Frank, whom the count yields, accepts and binds the ballots he was seated on
A stranger tries to open a cosigned act in the room: refused
Bob opens a cosigned act: his pending row, served to the room's active members
Dave adds his signature
Dave tries to take his signature back: refused, a signature given stays given
Bob opens another
Bob withdraws the pending act while it is still short
Carol tries to propose her own node as a witness: refused, a proposal is a founder's
Alice, a founder, proposes Carol's node as a witness of the lineage
Alice tries to accept for the node: refused, the answer is the owner's and never a founder's
Carol, the node's owner, accepts
Frank tries to revoke Dave's key: refused, the key is not his
Dave retires an old key under that key's own signature: recognised because the revoker is the key
Bob tries to sign the agent's retirement row: refused, up to retired the row is the agent's own
The agent signs its own retirement row
The agent signs the request to preserve its record, naming the operator and the period
The agent tries to answer its own request: refused, the answer is the operator's
Heidi, the operator the request names, accepts
After retired, the agent's key tries a custody row: refused, those are the listed custodian's
Ivan, the custodian the retired row lists, signs the custody row
Ivan revises the request: after retired, revisions are the custodian's
Ivan tries to name his own successor: refused, a replacement is the operator's and the Wise Authority's
Heidi and Grace name a successor in one cosigned row
Heidi tries to open the seal: refused, only a Wise Authority's row opens it
Grace opens the seal for one person's request
Grace tries to record a lawful order to release: refused, that record is the steward's
Bob records the order under his own name
Bob tries to state a duty: refused, the family names no signer, so the transition is shut to everyone
Bob tries to carry a framed revocation of his old phone: refused, the family names no signer, so the transition is shut to everyone
